name: ChatGPT & Claude Prompt Autopilot Extension 🛠️
description_md:
# What You Get

- The master “mega-prompt” (no code needed) to build your own Chrome extension for ChatGPT and Claude: auto-generates, queues, and stores optimized prompts on both platforms.

- The core blueprint for DOM injection, UI placement, prompt sequencing, model switching, and real-world fixes for quirky ChatGPT/Claude interfaces—explained in plain English.

- Link to Miro Board shown in video, walking through the steps needed to recreate the extension

If you want the plug-and-play Chrome extension files, they’re exclusive to the Early AI-dopters Community -- that’s where you’ll unlock the ready-to-import package and community-only upgrades! 😉
